physical_skill: Lift a thin 74 mm band, bring it down square over a loose 6 g disc on the jar rim, start it on a continuous glass thread without cross-threading, and turn it about 1.25 turns in several regrips until the flange seats on the disc, keeping the disc centred and the jar upright, then release.
valid_shortcuts: None that score: do nothing 0; set the band square on the jar unturned (rests 3.7+ mm up) 0; bring it down tilted (cocks or pushes off the disc) 0. One arm suffices in simulation (the filled jar does not spin on the counter); the task does not claim two-handedness. Revision: over-tightening (202 degrees past contact) scores 0.5; stopping at first resistance scores 1.0 (Ball guidance); a quarter turn short scores 0.5.
distinct_from_nearest: A two-piece closure: the threaded ring clamps a separate loose disc that it must not disturb, on a free-standing filled jar; nearest board tasks thread a one-piece cap, bottle or nut onto a fixed or rigid part, and the only canning task inspects sealed lids. Residual risk: reviewers may see screw-on closures as covered by #281/#1405/#3222.
